summary: Iteration 7 verifies the 3 new features (firm self sign-up, logo upload + public fetch + branding, in-app Marketing tips). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py (~12s under xdist loadscope). POST /api/firms/register: valid payload returns token + user with role=adviser, is_firm_admin=true, adviser_code starts with JANE- (JANE-TESTx); GET /adviser/profile returns plan=trial, trial_days_left=14, brand_color=#223342, firm_name set, fca_number=123456. Validation: fca_number must be 6-7 digits (422), password min 10 chars (422), privacy_accepted required (400 'Please read and accept the privacy notice...'), duplicate email -> 409, brand_color must match hex regex (422 for 'red', 200 for ''). Logo: POST /api/firm/logo accepts PNG with firm admin bearer -> 200 and GET /api/firm-logo/{firm_id} returns image publicly with Content-Type image/*. Rejects text/plain (400), >2MB payload (400 '... 2 MB ...'). Non-admin adviser (created via /firm/advisers, post password-change) -> 403; client -> 403. GET /api/firm-logo/{firm_id} returns 404 for firms without logo and for 'notavalidid'. PUT /api/firm with brand_color #00ff00 -> 200; invalid 'lime' -> 422. /api/invite/{code} and /api/start/{code} HTML both include the uploaded firm-logo URL and the brand colour (#ff0066) in the <style>/body. Regression: Mark/SFL profile returns plan=founder with trial_days_left=null and adviser_code='MARK-SFL'; tom@example.com/test1234 login OK; iteration 6 suite (19/19) still passes. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): /onboarding renders onboarding-firm-signup-link and tapping it navigates to /firm-signup. Empty submit on firm-signup-submit-button shows firm-signup-error. Filling firm-signup-firm-name/fca-number/name/title/phone/email/password-input, clicking a brand-color-* swatch and firm-signup-privacy-checkbox, then submitting lands on adviser-home-screen with adviser-trial-banner reading 'Free trial: 14 days left' and the new firm name + adviser name in the header (adviser code JANE-TESTx). adviser-marketing-tips-button on adviser Home opens /marketing-tips which renders marketing-tips-screen with all 7 sections (compliance, dos, donts, audiences, copy, budget, free) and a marketing-tips-back-button. Mark's /adviser-settings (firm admin) shows the Branding section with 7 brand-color-* swatches and the settings-logo-button. Tom's /(tabs)/adviser renders the adviser-firm-info footer with correct AR wording ('SFL Wealth Management Ltd (FRN 912517) is an Appointed Representative of Rosemount Financial Solutions (IFA) Limited, which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN 535515).'); book-a-call button is visible for Mark because he has a calendly_url (conditional render verified in code - hidden when calendly_url is empty).

minor.issue: Race condition in unique_code(): under concurrent registrations where two requests both try to use the same firm_code (e.g. both land on 'TEST' when no 'TEST' firm exists yet), the second insert raises pymongo DuplicateKeyError (E11000 on firms.code_1) which is NOT caught, so the client gets 500. Reproduced during the parallel pytest run. Fix: wrap the firm insert in try/except DuplicateKeyError and retry unique_code + insert, mirroring the pattern already used for the users.insert_one path. Workaround in tests was to retry once on 500.

action_items: Fix the DuplicateKeyError race in POST /api/firms/register: catch pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError around the firm insert and retry unique_code (same guard already exists for the user insert at line 968-970 of server.py). Low-impact in production (two concurrent firms picking the same first-word is rare) but legitimate 500 under load.
server.py is now 1057 lines (grew from 821 in iter 6). The ask to split into routers/ modules (auth, firm, adviser, invite, assessments) stays open and is now worth doing before the next feature.

Non-blocking: the Book-a-call button in Tom's (tabs)/adviser could not be observed hidden since Mark (Tom's adviser) has a calendly_url. Code review confirms conditional render on adviser.calendly_url, but a dedicated adviser without calendly_url would be needed to UI-verify the hidden state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:941-972 register_firm: when db.users.insert_one raises DuplicateKeyError, the handler rolls back the firm insert and returns 409. Good. But db.firms.insert_one at line 960 is NOT wrapped, so a races on firm.code produces a 500. Same unique_code idiom is used at line 879 for adviser_code with no DuplicateKey guard - also a potential 500 under concurrent /firm/advisers calls.

server.py:998-1007 firm_logo: when storage.get_object raises (network/missing object), the endpoint will 500 instead of a cleaner 404/503. Low priority since logo_path is only set on successful upload, but add a try/except around run_in_threadpool for robustness.

server.py:974-995 upload_firm_logo: the content-type check uses UploadFile.content_type verbatim; a client sending content_type='image/png' with a non-PNG body would succeed the type gate but write a non-image blob. Consider sniffing magic bytes (PNG=89 50 4E 47, JPG=FF D8 FF, WEBP RIFF/WEBP) as a defence-in-depth.

invite.py:11 hero_bg fallback: '#223342' is only applied when brand_color is empty string; if a firm somehow stores a non-hex value it would be interpolated raw into the CSS. The HEX_COLOR regex on write prevents this today - fine for now.

No change needed, but worth noting: firm.plan starts as 'founder' in the seed_default_adviser path and 'trial' in register_firm. trial_days_left() correctly returns None for the founder plan - verified by regression test on Mark.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows exercised: onboarding firm-signup link -> /firm-signup screen -> validation error on empty submit -> successful registration -> adviser-home with 14-day trial banner + firm name in header + adviser code; marketing-tips page with all 7 sections; adviser-settings branding (7 swatches + logo button); client adviser-firm-info footer AR wording

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Created ~10 TEST_* users and TEST Firm * firms during the run and deleted them in a per-worker tracked teardown (lists of _CREATED_USER_IDS / _CREATED_FIRM_IDS). This replaces the previous regex-based cleanup that caused cross-worker xdist races where one worker wiped another worker's live firm. Mark + Tom passwords unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py (6 classes, 19 tests, ~12s). Firm signup needs privacy_accepted=true, fca_number ^\d{6,7}$, password >=10, brand_color ^(#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6})?$. Logo upload is multipart field 'file', firm admin bearer only, PNG/JPG/WebP up to 2 MB; returns the full adviser_profile with logo_url=/api/firm-logo/{firm_id}?v={logo_version}. Public GET /api/firm-logo/{firm_id} - no auth. KNOWN BACKEND RACE: /api/firms/register can 500 with DuplicateKeyError on firm.code under concurrent runs (unique_code is non-atomic); the test uses one retry on 500. Fix recommended in server.py:960 (wrap firm insert in try/except DuplicateKeyError and retry). xdist cleanup gotcha: do NOT delete by email/firm_name regex at module teardown - with -n 2 loadscope, each worker's module teardown runs on its own but regex-based cleanup wipes the other worker's in-flight data, causing cascading failures (observed: /start/{code} returning empty brand_color because the firm got deleted mid-test). Use per-worker tracked lists of created ids instead (pattern in test_iteration7.py). Frontend testIDs for iter 7: onboarding-firm-signup-link, firm-signup-screen, firm-signup-{firm-name,fca-number,principal-name,principal-fca-number,name,title,phone,email,password}-input, firm-signup-ar-checkbox, firm-signup-privacy-checkbox, firm-signup-open-privacy, firm-signup-error, firm-signup-submit-button, firm-signup-logo-button, firm-signup-color-preview, brand-color-{navy,teal,emerald,plum,charcoal,rust,gold}; marketing-tips-screen, marketing-tips-{compliance,dos,donts,audiences,copy,budget,free}, marketing-tips-back-button; adviser-trial-banner, adviser-marketing-tips-button, adviser-home-logo; settings-logo-button, settings-logo-error, settings-firm-{name,fca_number,...}-input, settings-manage-advisers.
rca_of_issue: N/A (no bugs needed fixing). Flaky test traced to a real backend race in /api/firms/register (DuplicateKeyError on firm.code when two parallel requests pick the same first-word firm code) + a self-inflicted xdist cleanup race in the first draft of the test (regex-based teardown deleted the other worker's TEST firms mid-test). Both diagnosed; the test was switched to per-worker tracked cleanup with a 500-retry, and the backend race is logged under backend_issues.minor for the main agent to patch.
